description: B1.4' (module map, arm 2): the cyclotomic LEVEL correspondence — is the n-th Masbaum term a fixed n-independent dressing of the (n+k)-th GGM block term? Decided by exact cross-multiplication T^Mas_n·T^H_{n+1+k} == T^Mas_{n+1}·T^H_{n+k} in the u-series ring at O(u^96), over the extended λ-grid (33 rows) × level shifts k ∈ −2..2, Masbaum levels 0..8; depth-limited pairs reported, never counted as matches. Per-level u-parity recorded; levels re-summed against the B1.3 u-even total as a consistency gate. No numerics in the decision. auditOnly; no c_k wired; no fit.
